decision_change: Do not treat longer exciton lifetime as a monotonic standalone optimization target for the D18/PY-IT/eC9 bridge. In the published PM6/L8-BO/Y18-C3 series, the optimized ternary has a shorter reported exciton lifetime than PM6:L8-BO while simultaneously having higher FF and lower voltage loss. Lifetime remains a mechanism-relevant covariate, but field-dependent generation and useful-work metrics remain mandatory.

source.title: Overcoming the fill-factor limit of organic solar cells
source.location: main text Fig. 5 discussion and caption
source.notes: The source reports n=8 independent devices per ratio for FF/voltage-loss box plots; exciton lifetime/PLQY used two independent films and six measurements per ratio. The prose values below do not provide standard errors, so this packet does not invent measurement uncertainty.

governing_calculations.ordinal_counterexample: counterexample = (tau_ternary < tau_L8BO) AND (FF_ternary > FF_L8BO) AND (Vloss_ternary < Vloss_L8BO)

reporting_resolution_sensitivity.method: half of the last reported digit only; this is not physical uncertainty
conditions: ternary lifetime upper bound 870.5 ps < L8-BO lifetime lower bound 989.5 ps
ternary FF lower bound 0.8105 > L8-BO FF upper bound 0.7955
ternary voltage-loss upper bound 0.5165 V < L8-BO voltage-loss lower bound 0.5445 V

validity_domain: Cross-composition empirical benchmark in the reported PM6/L8-BO/Y18-C3 series only. It does not estimate a D18/PY-IT/eC9 lifetime optimum, isolate causality, or replace TDCF/bias-dependent PL/stabilized-Pmax measurements.
serious_conventional_explanations: Composition changes energetic offset and other electronic properties together with exciton lifetime; lifetime is not independently randomized.
Morphology, transport, contacts, absorption and recombination can covary across blends; the source reports AFM/GIWAXS controls but those do not make lifetime the unique cause.
falsifier: A controlled D18/PY-IT/eC9 intervention that changes exciton lifetime while holding relevant energetic, morphological, transport/contact and optical variables sufficiently fixed, and prospectively shows monotonic FF/field-generation improvement, would narrow or overturn the transfer of this counterexample to the project system.
next_physical_measurement: For blinded B0/B1/B2, acquire TCSPC or another justified exciton-lifetime observable alongside TDCF/bias-dependent PL and stabilized MPP; do not use lifetime alone as the acceptance gate.
